about_the_game:
🚀 Welcome to the Final Frontier of Idle Games

Mine the galaxy, upgrade your ship, and uncover the mysteries of deep space in this addictive idle clicker where your journey is just beginning.

🪐 Mine Across the Cosmos

Start small on a dusty asteroid and work your way up to harvesting rare resources from moons, planets, stars, black holes, and even stranger celestial anomalies. Each location is a new panel with its own art, mining speed, and resource types—ready to tap, automate, and dominate.

🧪 Manufacture. Upgrade. Progress.

Turn raw resources into powerful factory equipment to upgrade your ship. The stronger your ship, the deeper you can venture into the galaxy. Progress through multiple tiers of upgrades, each unlocking new mining zones and rewarding gameplay loops.

👩‍🚀 Assemble Your Crew

Rescue stranded crew members through long-term expeditions and assign them to your team. Each crew member provides a unique buff—some double your iron yield, some boost drop rates, and others slash mining times. Choose up to 4 at a time to build the perfect synergy for your strategy.

🧠 Strategic Automation

Go from frantic clicking to smooth automation. Automate your mines, speed up production, and optimize every aspect of your empire. Set it up right, and let your operation run itself—even when you’re away.

🎨 Pixel Art. Big Ideas.

Enjoy a handcrafted pixel art aesthetic set against a backdrop of stars, planets, and cosmic effects. Minimalist yet expressive, the visuals are designed to deliver satisfying feedback with every tap and upgrade.

🌌 The Universe Never Sleeps

Whether you’re actively playing or stepping away, the game continues to mine and grow. Check in, collect, upgrade, repeat. Your galactic empire is always working, even when you’re not.

Get ready to mine, build, and blast your way across the stars. Your space adventure begins now.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1+
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD 4000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad-core 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics (NVIDIA GTX 750 / AMD Radeon HD 7770 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Runs great on modern low- to mid-tier systems.
